# KRB Construction

KRB Construction is a family-owned general contractor in West Los Angeles.
The shop is at 2774 Sawtelle Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90064.
Karl Brook runs KRB Construction under California licence 485282, General Building, since 1986.
The work is kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, room additions, whole-home remodels, and design with plans.
The crew is in-house for every phase of the job.
The shop serves Mar Vista, West Los Angeles, and the greater Los Angeles area.
Office hours are Monday to Friday 9 to 5 and Saturday 10 to 2.
The phone number is (310) 766-5555.
To start, call for an appointment to meet and talk through the project.
